entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return something. My VeloBand Pulse.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your account number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?

Thank you, Sam. I see your recent order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
There's no issue. I just changed my mind. I barely even use it.
I understand. So you're looking to return it because you're not using it as much as you thought you would?
It was an impulse buy. I don't use it. I want my money back. Fine?
Okay, one moment while I check the return eligibility for you... Alright, I'm looking at your order details and our policy. It looks like your purchase was 36 days ago.
Right. So is that a problem?

Not at all. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. Since you're well within that window, I can go ahead and process this return for you immediately. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label.
Oh. Well, that was surprisingly easy. I was expecting a fight.

We try to make it as simple as possible. The email with the label and instructions is on its way to you now. Once we receive the item, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can help with?
No. Whatever. I'll look for the email.
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, Sam. Have a good day.
